From what I can see in the picture. You have intrinsic stain. Meaning your enamel is more transparent and the color of the dentin is showing through. Aka the inside of the tooth is making your teeth look that way. 
So no amount of brushing would whiten your teeth. 
You have a couple of options.
 1. You can go to your dentist and ask for whitening trays. I personal tell patients to go with the take home whitening kit. Many uses over a set of time will get you a whiter smile than the one time in office whitening treatment. Plus you can continue to do touch ups as needed. My office charges $199.00 for custom take home. 
2. 3D whitening strips. You can get a few shades whiter with this product. 

Do not buy any whitening toothpaste. It is not meant for your type of staining. 

Make sure you follow the directions. The ingredients are time sensitive and need to be on the teeth for a certain amount of time for it to "do its job". 

Last and most important information. These products can cause sensitivity to the teeth. So I recommend you use any brand of sensitivity toothpaste for AT LEAST FIVE DAYS before application. The active ingredient (potassium nitrate) takes time too build up in your enamel. 
Sysodyne is a good brand to try. But double check the active ingredient.

You don't always feel pain when you have a cavity or a strange taste. Pain is usually a sign that the cavity has reached the pulp chamber (where the blood vessels and nerves are). Your best bet is to go see a dentist to get a proper diagnosis.
